# The first review approves: one plan, one implement, one review, no fix round. The pull request is marked ready.
exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.hcl
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged$'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^review ' calls.log
! grep '^fix ' calls.log

# The fake implementer stages everything. The example forbids it, so the review sees the violation and the run goes on.
grep -count=1 '^bulk-staging: git add -A$' seen.log
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
